findings.claim: CLAUDE.md and the sim barrel both say other layers import the sim only through src/sim/index.ts, but 8 imports in render, UI and input go straight to sim/types.ts or sim/track.ts. render/props.ts imports three constants that the barrel doesn't export at all, so the next feature night will copy the deep-import pattern.
findings.evidence: src/sim/index.ts:1 "Render, UI, input and driver code import only from here." CLAUDE.md: "import the sim only via `src/sim/index.ts`". Deep imports: src/render/props.ts:9 `import { HAY_BALE_LENGTH, HAY_BALE_WIDTH, TYRE_STACK_RADIUS } from '../sim/track.ts'` (not exported by index.ts:5, which only has `trackLayout, validateTrack`); src/render/props.ts:8, src/render/scene.ts:16, src/render/track.ts:5, src/ui/race-ui.ts:5, src/ui/format.ts:2, src/ui/results-screen.ts:7, src/input/index.ts:3 all `from '../sim/types.ts'`. Meanwhile src/render/car.ts:11 and src/render/dust.ts:11 already use '../sim/index.ts'.
findings.suggestedFix: Add `HAY_BALE_LENGTH, HAY_BALE_WIDTH, TYRE_STACK_RADIUS` to the `./track.ts` re-export in src/sim/index.ts:5. Then point those 8 import lines at '../sim/index.ts'. types.ts is already `export *`, so the names are identical. Type-only, no runtime change. race-ui.ts, results-screen.ts (PR #26) and input/index.ts (PR #25) are in open PRs, so do those after the PRs land.

findings.claim: The render barrel re-exports about 12 names that nothing outside src/render imports: no src module, test, gate or harness file. The only consumer in src is game.ts (createRaceScene, createRenderer, RaceScene).
findings.evidence: src/render/index.ts:5 `frameWidthFor, type CameraRig`; :6 `type CarObject`; :7 `type DustPool`; :8 `LIGHT_DIRECTION, TOON_STEPS, type Materials`; :9 `attachOutline, groundMesh, outlinedFlatMesh, solidMesh, type RenderRole` (the whole line). Grep for `\b(frameWidthFor|attachOutline|groundMesh|outlinedFlatMesh|solidMesh|RenderRole|LIGHT_DIRECTION|TOON_STEPS|CameraRig|DustPool|CarObject|Materials)\b` over tests/, guardrails/ and harness/ finds nothing. harness/screens/scene.ts uses only playerLivery, createRaceScene, createMaterials and buildCar.
findings.suggestedFix: Drop those names from the re-export lines in src/render/index.ts and delete line 9. Keep every name that tests or gates use: createRaceScene, buildCar, createMaterials, playerLivery, CELL_SIZE, PlacedProp, CAMERA, cameraAngles, cameraDistance, createCameraRig, cabinColour, validateLivery, CAR, CarLivery, createDust, DUST, isFactoryMaterial, toonShade, TOP_FACE_MIN_Y, addRamp, PROPS, CHUNK_ROWS, LAYER, MeshBuilder, allNormalsUp, pixelRatio, MAX_PIXEL_RATIO, createRenderer, RaceScene. Also update the line 1–2 comment.

findings.claim: The stage fixture hard-codes the game's minimap stride as a bare `8`, and its comment says "as in the game". If MINIMAP_STRIDE in game.ts changes, the staged HUD silently stops matching the real one.
findings.evidence: src/game.ts:30 `const MINIMAP_STRIDE = 8;` and src/game.ts:251 `world.track.layout.centre.filter((_, i) => i % MINIMAP_STRIDE === 0)`. src/ui/stages/stage.ts:66 `(every 8th centreline point, as in the game)` and :71 `outline: centre.filter((_, i) => i % 8 === 0)`.
findings.suggestedFix: Move the stride into the UI as an exported helper, e.g. `minimapOutline(centre)` next to the minimap code (a UI module both files already import from, such as src/ui/race-ui.ts). Call it from game.ts:251 and stage.ts:71 and delete MINIMAP_STRIDE from game.ts. game.ts is in open PRs #25/#26, so do this after they land.

findings.claim: Three CLAUDE.md statements about the seams don't match the code: race-ui's job (it drives results and pause screens, not the finish panel), registration by folder (cars and screens don't register by folder), and the content layout (there are no cars or features folders).
findings.evidence: CLAUDE.md: "`src/ui/race-ui.ts` turns each frame's `RaceView` into HUD, countdown and finish-panel updates." vs src/ui/race-ui.ts:1 "(HUD, countdown, touch controls, results and pause screens)": it imports createResultsScreen/createPauseScreen and never finish-panel.ts. CLAUDE.md: "tracks, cars and screens register by being in their folder (`import.meta.glob`)" vs cars being a hand-edited `ROSTER` array (src/content/drivers.ts:12), and screens imported directly (src/game.ts:24-25). The only globs are src/content/tracks.ts:6 and src/ui/stages/registry.ts:6. Layout: "src/content  tracks (src/content/tracks/*.json), cars, features" vs src/content containing only tracks/, tracks.ts and drivers.ts.
findings.suggestedFix: Change the race-ui line to "…into HUD, countdown, results-screen and pause-screen updates". Change the registration line to "tracks and screen stages register by being in their folder…", and note that the driver roster (liveries) is data in src/content/drivers.ts. Change the layout line to "tracks (src/content/tracks/*.json), driver roster (drivers.ts)".
